simulations.title: A pool of 40
simulations.description: Payment calls wait off-thread for one of forty connections. Order status only calls Orders DB and keeps completing during the slowdown. Payments queued longer than the gateway’s five-second timeout fail there; provider work continues.

simulations.title: Blocking waits still hold threads
simulations.description: The same pool holds waiting threads as well as connections. Order-status work queues behind them. Payments queued longer than the gateway’s five-second timeout fail there; provider work continues.
